newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia ratifies controversial AMOCO oil probe deal.
newsitem.headline: Latvia ratifies controversial AMOCO oil probe deal.

text.p: Latvia's parliament on Thursday ratified a deal with Chicago-based Amoco Corp. and the Swedish company OPAB to begin prospecting for oil in a disputed sea zone also claimed by neighbouring Lithuania.
"Latvia's actions will not lead to a resolution of this conflict," Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas was quoted as saying on Latvian radio.

Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Stankevicius said that his government would cease negotiations with the Latvians over the issue and leave it in the hands of the next Lithuanian government. The dispute has soured relations between the two Baltic neighbours.
Both countries are keen on developing their own energy sources to reduce their dependency on Russia for fuel supplies.
